name: MidasCapitalXYZ
fix_description: Compound V2 fork share inflation attack. Exchange rate = (cash + totalBorrows - totalReserves) / totalSupply. When totalSupply is minimal (1 wei), attacker donates tokens to inflate cash, making exchange rate extremely large. Subsequent minters get 0 shares (integer division). Attacker redeems their 1 share for all funds. Fix: require minimum initial deposit with dead shares, or add virtual offset to prevent division precision loss.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC involves a long multi-contract attack chain with nested V2/V3 flash liquidity, LP mint/redeem manipulation, vault deposits, lending market collateral/borrow flows, and custom helper contracts to abuse protocol accounting. Writing it requires deep understanding of this specific protocol’s oracle/collateral logic and state transitions across several markets, which is well beyond a straightforward exploit.
